blocks.title: Isomers
blocks.text: Do ya do se zyada compounds jin ka molecular formula aik ho lekin atoms ki tarteeb aur properties mukhtalif hon, isomers kehlate hain, aur is cheez ko isomerism kehte hain.
Organic compounds mein isomerism do alag wajahon se paida hoti hai:

items: Jab do ya zyada molecules mein wahi groups ya atoms mukhtalif jagahon par jure hon, to structural ya constitutional isomerism hoti hai. Yeh qism Chemistry 11 mein parhi ja chuki hai.
Jab isomers mein substituents ya groups ki space (khala) mein tarteeb (spatial arrangement) mukhtalif ho, to kehte hain ke un ki configuration mukhtalif hai. Is qism ko stereoisomerism kehte hain.

blocks.alt: Isomers (aik molecular formula) do mein: Constitutional (jor mukhtalif): i. Chain, ii. Position, iii. Functional, iv. Metamers, v. Tautomers; aur Stereoisomers (jor wahi, khala mein rukh mukhtalif). Stereoisomers: bond tore baghair gardish se badalte hain? No: Configurational; Yes: Conformational. Configurational: gardish ruki hui? No: Optical; Yes: Geometrical. Optical: aaina shakal par na baithne wali? Yes: Enantiomers; No: Diastereomers.
blocks.caption: Isomers ki taqseem (kitab ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Chart ko oopar se neeche sawalon ki tarah parhein. Har shaakh par aik sawal likha hai aur us ke do jawab hain: Yes ya No. Maslan stereoisomers par sawal hai: kya yeh sirf single bond ke ghoomne se, koi bond tore baghair, aik doosre mein badal jate hain? Haan to conformational (jaise butane ki shakalein), nahi to configurational. Phir poocha jata hai ke rotation ruka hua (restricted, jaise C=C par) hai ya nahi.

blocks.prompt: Ethanol aur methoxymethane dono C₂H₆O hain. Yeh kis qism ke isomers hain?
blocks.explanation: Constitutional (structural) isomers, khaas taur par functional group isomers: aik alcohol hai aur aik ether.

items: Isomers: molecular formula aik, atoms ki tarteeb aur properties mukhtalif.
Constitutional isomers: atoms mukhtalif jagah jure hain. Stereoisomers: jor wahi, space mein tarteeb mukhtalif.
